# Set up environment

```{r}
#| label: setup-env
# Load in packages
if (!require("pacman")) {
  install.packages("pacman")
}
pacman::p_load(tidyverse, here, officer, flextable, sf)

# Set working directory
here::i_am("scripts/L1/101_combine_raw_EPT.qmd")

# Point to directories
L0_data_dir <- here("data", "L0") # L0 data
L1_data_dir <- here("data", "L1") # L1 data
```

# Read data

Duplicates were accidentally created when pulling data from the API because
API pulls were done in chunks or paused, leading to some accidental overlaps
and re-pulls of the same data. Optionally, [examine duplicate records](#check-dupes)

```{r}
#| label: read-raw-data
# Read all data
raw_e <- read_csv(here(L0_data_dir, "001a_obs_ephemeroptera.csv"))
raw_p <- read_csv(here(L0_data_dir, "001b_obs_plecoptera.csv"))
raw_t <- read_csv(here(L0_data_dir, "001c_obs_trichoptera.csv"))

# Combine into one dataset
raw_all <- bind_rows(raw_e, raw_p, raw_t) |>
  distinct() # remove duplicates

# Clean up environment & memory
rm(raw_e, raw_p, raw_t)
```

# Export data

```{r}
#| label: export-data
# Get lat/long info for SHP
EPT_sf <- raw_all |>
  select(id, location) |>
  filter(!is.na(location)) |>
  mutate(
    lat = as.numeric(str_extract(location, "^[^,]+")),
    long = as.numeric(str_extract(location, "[^,]+$")),
  ) |>
  st_as_sf(coords = c("long", "lat"), crs = 4326)

# Save raw EPT observation data as CSV
write_csv(raw_all, here(L1_data_dir, "101a_raw_EPT_obs.csv"))

# Create directory to save SHP
dir.create(here(L1_data_dir, "101b_raw_EPT_obs_shp"))
st_write(
  EPT_sf,
  here(L1_data_dir, "101b_raw_EPT_obs_shp", "101b_raw_EPT_obs_shp.shp")
)
```
